https://www.dw.com/en/iran-warns-countri.text: Skip to content Skip to main menu Skip to more DW sites https://p.dw.com/p/5JGT8 Mohsen Rezaei, the secretary of Iran's powerful Supreme National Security Council, has vowed Tehran will retaliate against further economic pressure from the US and its allies Image: tabnak Advertisement Iran on Saturday warned countries against joining the United States ' campaign to isolate the Iranian economy. "We declare to all countries... do not join the economic war waged by the United States," said Mohsen Rezaei, the head of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, on state television. "Any country participating in the imposition of economic restrictions against us is considered an enemy," he added. As the war nears its six-month anniversary, US President Donald Trump announced earlier this week what he called the "most crushing economic operation" against Tehran . Should Trump "take action, our confrontation will be like an earthquake," said Rezaei. US urges others to back Iran sanctions Washington has also called on other governments to join its efforts to ramp up economic pressure against Iran. But China , one of Iran's top strategic partners, has criticized the new campaign, arguing that "sanctions and pressure will not help resolve the issue." "China calls on all relevant parties to take responsible measures and resolve the problem through political and diplomatic means," Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian told reporters on Friday. The United Arab Emirates , a major trading partner for sanctioned Iran, already announced on Wednesday that it was cutting all financial and economic ties with Tehran until further notice. The decision was made in "light of escalations that undermine peace and security in the region," the UAE said in a statement . US-Iran war: Will it ever end? US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is expected to hold a press conference at 2 p.m. EDT (1800 GMT) on Monday to give further details of the economic measures against Iran. "This is going to be the greatest coordinated economic isolation in the history of the world. And we are going to them and saying you are either with us or against us,” Bessent said. Pictures by Marvin Strauss Arcadia Live, the German-Austrian promoter JV formed in 2015 is setting the course for the future of its concert business with the promotion of Florian Plakolm, who will take over as head promoter, effective Nov. 1, 2026. Plakom takes over from Arcadia Live founder and current Head Promoter Filip Potocki, who will remain involved with the company as Managing Director and focus on parent company FKP Scorpio’s Polish business. Plakolm has been a booker at Arcadia Live for almost five years, playing a key role in the development of the company’s concert and festival portfolio. Among other projects, he has been responsible for programming LIDO SOUNDS in Linz and the renowned METAStadt Open Air concert series in Vienna. His career highlights include prestigious bookings by Austrian artists, such as two sold out Soap&Skin concerts at the world-famous Vienna State Opera, as well as shows by international headliners and emerging talents including Air, Blood Orange, Chet Faker, Babyshambles, Flo Rida, Garbage, Idles, Jungle, Khruangbin, Little Simz, Max Richter, Sofia Isella, and Yung Lean. In his new role as head promoter, Plakolm will take on a central role in the strategic development of the Austrian promoter’s concert business. Arcadia Live was formed in early 2015 , when German promoters Four Artists, Chimperator Live, KKT and FKP Scorpio joined forces with Austrian full-service agency Arcadia. Arcadia Live founder and current head promoter Filip Potocki will remain involved with the company as managing director, continuing to work closely with parent company FKP Scorpio (part of the Eventim Live promoter network) while also remaining at the helm of FKP Scorpio Poland, where further personnel changes and additions are underway. Comments: Florian Plakolm, “I’m very grateful for the trust placed in me and excited about the opportunity to help shape the next chapter of Arcadia Live in my new role as Head Promoter. We have a fantastic team and are already working on plenty of exciting projects and shows for 2027 and beyond. I’m looking forward to everything the coming months and years will bring.” Filip Potocki, commenting on his long-standing colleague’s new role and responsibilities in Austria, as well as the personnel changes in Poland, said, “We’ve built Arcadia Live over the past few years with a great deal of passion. Flo has played a key role in that journey and has more than earned this new position. I’m delighted that he’ll be taking on greater responsibility at Arcadia Live. I’ll remain Managing Director, continuing to contribute my experience and provide support and guidance wherever needed. With Flo by my side in Vienna, I’ll also be able to focus more on my role as Head Promoter at FKP Scorpio Poland, where Jakub Soczewko is strengthening the booking team, bringing many years of industry experience.” Subscribe to Pollstar HERE Tags # Arcadia Live # Austria # CTS Eventim # FKP Scorpio FREE Daily Pulse Subscribe
